items.subject: Charged $4,200 after the trial ended
items.aiDraft: Asha — Relay shows the Northwind trial closed on 24 Aug and a $4,200 annual seat invoice posted this morning. I can void that charge and keep the workspace on the trial hold until Kavya confirms the conversion. Reply yes if you want the refund posted today.

messages.author: Asha Rao
messages.body: We never converted. The trial ended 24 Aug and we were going to stay on the free workspace. This morning finance saw a $4,200 charge. Please reverse it before the card statement closes.

messages.author: Relay copilot
messages.body: Draft ready: void the annual invoice, keep Northwind on trial hold, and ping Kavya for conversion confirmation.

items.subject: SSO SAML loop after Okta cert rotation
items.aiDraft: Liam — I rotated the Relay ACS to the new Okta cert. Sign in once from an incognito window and send me the assertion timestamp if the loop is still there.

messages.author: Liam Chen
messages.body: Clinicians are bouncing between Okta and Relay after we rotated the signing cert at 13:10 CT. Nobody can reach the weekend census board.

messages.author: Meera Poluru
messages.body: I see the old cert still pinned on the Relay side. Send the new metadata XML and I will swap it without bouncing the other IdPs.

messages.author: Liam Chen
messages.body: Metadata attached. We need this before the 17:00 shift change.

items.subject: Invoice PDF is missing line items
items.aiDraft: Nina — the August PDF dropped the overage rows. I regenerated INV-8841 with the three usage lines and attached it here.

messages.author: Nina Voss
messages.body: INV-8841 totals $1,180 but the PDF only shows the base seat line. AP will reject it.

messages.author: Kavya Poluru
messages.body: Confirmed — the renderer skipped usage rows after Friday's invoice template change. Regenerating now.

items.subject: Copilot suggested the wrong refund amount
items.aiDraft: Jonah — the $890 draft was wrong. The unused seats are $240. I voided the bad credit and issued the correct one.

messages.author: Jonah Park
messages.body: Your bot offered an $890 refund for two unused hygienist seats. Those seats are $120 each. Please do not post $890.

messages.author: Harini Poluru
messages.body: Holding the draft. Relay pulled annual instead of monthly. I will send the corrected credit once Kavya signs off.

items.subject: Cannot export last month's tickets
items.aiDraft: Priya — the July export is queued. You will get a signed link in the portal within the hour.

messages.author: Priya Nair
messages.body: CSV export spins and dies at 82%. We need July for the franchise review on Tuesday.

messages.author: Madhav Poluru
messages.body: The job is dying on the custom field with the emoji column. I am splitting the export and will send two files.

items.subject: Webhook deliveries hitting 429
items.aiDraft: Diego — Relay is retrying the dock-scan topic with jitter. I raised your burst to 120/min until Monday.

messages.author: Diego Alvarez
messages.body: Dock scans are backing up. Every ticket.updated webhook is 429. Weekend yard is running on paper.

items.subject: Dark mode contrast on the agent reply box

messages.author: Mira Shah
messages.body: The reply composer in dark mode is grey on grey. Agents are typing into the wrong field.

messages.author: Subrahmanyam Poluru
messages.body: Shipped in 1.18. Contrast is 7.2:1 on the composer now. Closing this out.

items.subject: Seat invite bounced for a new hygienist
items.aiDraft: Jonah — the invite hit a plus-address filter. I resent it to the clinic domain and added her to the front-desk group.

messages.author: Jonah Park
messages.body: Invite to rina+clinic@atlas.example bounced. She starts Tuesday and needs the chair-side macros.

items.subject: Refund policy article is a year out of date
items.aiDraft: Elena — the 14-day window is now 7 days for annual plans. I queued a rewrite of KB-204 for Harini.

messages.author: Elena Cho
messages.body: Your help article still says 14-day refunds. Finance was told 7 days on the last QBR.

items.subject: Weekend coverage missed a P2 page
items.aiDraft: Liam — we missed the 02:04 page. I am writing a credit and a coverage postmortem for Ananya's Saturday rotation.

messages.author: Liam Chen
messages.body: The census board was down from 02:04 to 03:40. Nobody picked up the P2.

messages.author: Meera Poluru
messages.body: Confirmed breach. Ananya was on the overflow line, not the health channel. Credit and write-up coming today.

items.subject: AI draft included a patient MRN
items.aiDraft: Elena — the draft never sent. Relay redacted the MRN and I pulled that thread from the model cache.

messages.author: Elena Cho
messages.body: A suggested reply showed MRN 44819-22 in the composer. It did not send. We still need confirmation it is gone.

messages.author: Harini Poluru
messages.body: Redacted and evicted. I am adding a PHI filter to the clinic macro pack before we turn drafts back on.

items.subject: Refund macro is too aggressive
items.aiDraft: Asha — I paused the auto-refund macro. Credits over $200 now require Kavya.

messages.author: Asha Rao
messages.body: Your agents keep offering a full-year credit when we ask about a single unused seat.

items.subject: Mobile push is not firing for new tickets
items.aiDraft: Mira — iOS 18.6 dropped the Relay token. Reinstall from TestFlight 3.4 and I will watch the next page.

messages.author: Mira Shah
messages.body: On-call did not get the 10:40 page on iPhone. Badge stayed at zero.

items.subject: Merge two customer records after acquisition

messages.author: Nina Voss
messages.body: Please merge Yardlight into Harbor Freight Cloud. Same billing entity after Friday's close.

messages.author: Meera Poluru
messages.body: Merged. Tickets, seats, and the Harbor SLA pack now live under one account.
